decisions: Headline kept as the quote headline 'Everyone Is a Slave to the System', which is what the Hebrew prints and what a magazine would run.
'זר פסלונים בכיסו' (a bouquet of statuettes in his pocket, a mixed image in the Hebrew) rendered 'a pocketful of statuettes'; the pocket is kept, the bouquet dropped.
'מוגדר כאדם חופשי' rendered 'a free man on paper' rather than 'defined as a free man'.
'בלי הנחות לאף אחד' rendered 'nobody gets a pass' rather than the literal 'no discounts for anyone'.
'ירדו למחילה' (a strange Hebrew phrase, probably a rendering of 'went down a hole') translated as 'they went down a hole' after 'went mad'; the earlier 'went down into a burrow' was a literalism.
'40 מעלות' rendered 'above 40 degrees Celsius'; the unit is added so an American reader does not picture a cold day.
'מתפתה להצטרף לנסיעת עבודה' rendered 'is lured onto a work trip', which is what happened to Northup, rather than 'is tempted to join'.
Caption 'בלי לתפור חליפות' rendered 'Not getting fitted for a suit' so that it points at the tuxedo exchange below it.
Subtitle drops the closing 'he says in an interview' to 'he says' is also dropped: the quote stands at the end, as in the W186 reference subtitle.
Tags set to the brief's typical international-interview set: Interview, Film, Hollywood, New York (byline New York).
